Segment soundness uses external fuel induction. Moving pointwise minimum offsets into the base sets both tested offsets to zero; decrementing the common base preserves the normalized successor relation. Both segment clocks include the final test or halt, so they are positive.

One Σ1 induction yields related or jointly halted states with both clocks above every internal bound. Absorbing zero and related-state liveness prove both halting directions, including overshoot.
